text: Being here, I am struck by a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The environment is clearly designed for exploration and learning, a modern exhibition of creativity and innovation. The bold colors and interactive displays invite me to reflect on the evolving relationship between humans and knowledge. The very idea of R+D on the wall speaks to endless possibilities—how every moment, even now, is part of a larger experiment in understanding. I feel both small and connected, a participant in the ongoing dialogue between discovery and experience.
